«الخوف من الخسارة» — fear of loss → clinging pushes away; التعلق المرضي vs secure love; check fear: reality or past
«الميزان» — the one who gives alone burns out; العبء الذهني vs expenses; balance effort, don't keep score

«الراحة قتلات الحب؟» — Too much comfort (pyjamas, phone, routine) kills spark; zero comfort kills safety. Need both: الأمان + شوية ديال الجديد.

topic: الضحك فالخصومة — Defuse small silly fights with humour (agree and exaggerate) instead of defending. Not for serious issues.
البرودة فالخصومة — Staying calm when the other shouts: don't match the volume. Breathe, lower your voice, answer later. Calm wins the argument.
المزيان بزاف — Being 'too nice' = saying yes to avoid conflict, hidden resentment. Kind ≠ no limits. Applies to girls too ('the nice girl').
كتراقب راسك بزاف — Over-thinking how you look/sound in front of your partner makes you stiff. Ease and being yourself is attractive.
قول «لا» وخليه حر — A good partner can disagree honestly and still respect the other's choices. Not a yes-man, not a jailer.
الحب بلا قفص — Love grows with freedom, dies in a cage. Jealousy/locking down pushes people out. Trust + own life + come back by choice.
الحياة فعينيك — People are attracted to someone who loves their own life (hobbies, goals, energy), not someone whose whole life is the partner.
الاهتمام عملة — Attention is the real currency of love; phones steal it. 10 minutes of full attention > 3 hours side by side on the phone.
كلشي ولا ساهل — Apps, swiping, delivery: we expect love to be instant too and quit at the first difficulty. Real love is built, not ordered.
الجهة المظلمة ديالك — Everyone has jealousy, anger, ego. Hiding it makes it explode; owning it ('I get jealous, help me') makes you stronger as a couple.
نصايح الرجال vs العيالات — Funny contrast: what men tell men vs what women tell women about love; both extremes are wrong; the truth is in the middle. Debate, no hate.
حقائق على الفراق — Hard truths for both: stalking the ex's stories keeps the wound open, rebound relationships, closure comes from you, time + no contact heals.
واش كلشي نرجسي؟ — Today every ex is a 'نرجسي'. Real narcissism vs normal bad behaviour; using the label to avoid looking at your own part. Debate.
علامات البعاد — Signs a partner is drifting away (phone face-down, less sharing, irritation) — for both sexes; talk early instead of spying.
العلاقة من بعيد — Brutal truths about long distance (Morocco/abroad couples): needs an end date, rituals, trust; video calls ≠ life together.
ما تبقاش تبرر — Over-explaining and justifying every little thing in a fight looks guilty and drags it on. Say it once, clearly.
شنو حنا؟ — The 'situationship' pain: not knowing what you are. Uncertainty hurts more than a clear no. Ask the question.
الاحترام قبل الحب — You can't stay attracted to someone you don't respect; contempt (الاحتقار) is the #1 predictor of divorce (Gottman).
كتقتل اللي جاب الخبر — When your partner raises a problem, attacking them for saying it instead of hearing it. Criticism vs complaint.
واش ترجع للإكس؟ — Debate: going back to an ex — when it can work (both changed) vs when it's just loneliness. Both sexes.
الغيرة — Why we suddenly want someone when others want them; jealousy as a signal vs jealousy as control. Both sexes.
اللعب فالعلاقة — Everyone says 'I don't play games' but we all do (late replies, jealousy bait); small games vs manipulation, the safety-vs-fear test.
كنبغيو اللي تعبنا عليه — We love what we invest in (IKEA effect): couples who build things together bond more; effort must be shared. Both sexes.
السبب الأول ديال الفراق — Effort stops after the 'yes'/wedding: no more dates, sweet words, curiosity. What you did to win them, keep doing. Both sexes.
لغات الحب — The 5 love languages: you love in your language, your partner hears another one; ask each other which one.
كاين ولا لا؟ — Emotional unavailability: physically there but absent; 3 signs (flees feelings, hot-cold, always busy); why we chase the distant one and find calm 'boring'. Both sexes.
الاختبارات — Both partners test each other ('would you still love me?'); a test is a hidden question about safety; pass by staying calm and honest, not by winning.
كيفاش تنتاقد بلا ما تجرح — Criticize the action not the person, in private not in public, always with a clear request; the listener's role; 5 good words for 1 hard.
حتى واحد ما كيشبع — Hedonic adaptation (التعوّد): not 'women/men are never satisfied', everyone's brain normalizes the good; fight it with daily gratitude and new shared experiences.
نصايح صحابك — Friends' advice can wreck a couple: they hear one side, project their own story, and keep the grudge after you make up; who to ask, keep small fights private.
الملل — Boredom invents fake fights; routine kills dopamine — fix the routine, not the partner: new places, food, hobbies together.

شكون خاصو يبادر؟ — Debate: in Morocco should only the man make the first move? Both sides (effort/feeling wanted vs rejection hurts men too, shy women stay silent); initiative matters after marriage too.
الوجه الأول — At the start we show our best version; the real face shows under stress (tired, travel, money, how they treat others) — for both sexes; see it before marriage and show yours.
دخل لعالمو — Phone, fixing or changing the topic tells your partner their world doesn't matter; empathy = curious questions about their work drama and hobbies; 3 rules.
الهضرة ولات تحقيق — Couple talk turned into a checklist/interrogation (ate? where were you?) — a company, not lovers; bring back play, jokes, stories and shared dreams.
بغيه… بلا ما تذوب فيه — Show you want your partner (kind words, time, joy) without melting into them; keep your friends, work and dreams so desire lives in the small distance. Both sexes.
